blocks.text: Product Description               Bring home the magic of a real ice cream shop with the Melissa & Doug Wooden Scoop & Serve Ice Cream Counter. This 28-piece set offers everything young chefs need to scoop, stack, and serve delicious treats. An amazing addition to any toddler kitchen playset, this Melissa and Doug ice cream set includes eight colorful scoops, six tasty toppings, cones, a cup, utensils, a menu card, and play money — inspiring hours of creative, screen-free fun. Kids love the vibrant colors & details, while parents appreciate its quality and educational value, making it a standout among toddler learning toys for boys and girls alike. For more thrilling role play, combine this with Melissa & Doug toys like a toy vending machine, an Ice Cream toy playset & other play kitchen accessories, to build a pretend play world! For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!                  From the Manufacturer               From classic wooden toys to crafts, pretend play, and games, Melissa & Doug products provide a launch pad to ignite imagination and a sense of wonder in all children so they can discover themselves, their passions, and their purpose.

Since the company’s founding more than 25 years ago, Melissa & Doug has consistently delivered innovative products that inspire open-ended thinking, encourage kids to see new possibilities, and offer Countless Ways to Play. It’s part of a bigger vision to Take Back Childhood. Because by giving children a true childhood with the space and freedom to explore their world, we give them a path to realizing their full potential!

items.label: Complete Ice Cream Shop
items.value: Kids love scooping & stacking bright wooden scoops & toppings, with a kid friendly ice cream toy scooper, & serving on a countertop with special ports to hold all their treats

items.label: Skill-Building Pretend Play Toys
items.value: Kids will boost their memory, hand-eye coordination & counting skills by remembering orders, customizing meals & handling play money, just like a real ice cream shop

items.label: Open-Ended, Screen-Free Play
items.value: This premium set of wooden toys features smooth finishes, vibrant toy kitchen accessories, & a sturdy countertop—which also doubles as a toy storage box, for easy cleanup

items.label: Educational Toys for Any Occasion
items.value: When buying a birthday gift & holiday gifts for kids, or rewarding little milestones, celebrate the moments that matter with Melissa and Doug toys for boys & girls

items.label: Wholesome Play for 35+ Years
items.value: Melissa & Doug inspires kid-powered play with its learning toys for kids, baby & toddler toys, puzzles, games, building toys & stuffed animals, dolls, & even a doll house

items.label: Included Components
items.value: counter, 8 wooden ice cream scoops, 6 toppings, 2 cones, plastic cup, scooper, wooden spoon, tongs, reusable menu card, six bills
